preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of roads E must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect cities within the valid range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by E lines representing the final orientation of the roads.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N for a, b in final_roads)
postconditions.description: The final orientation of the roads must connect cities within the valid range of 1 to N.
